tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// rgyal bu no mo gan la spring ba'i rab byed bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal bu no mo gan la spring ba'i rab tu byed pa/ tshigs su bcad pa brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis mngon par mtho ba dang*// nges par legs pa'i tshul lugs kun// spyad pas srid zhi'i dpal gyur pa// thub dbang de la phyag 'tshal lo// ma bskul yang ni bdag gi yid// khyod la gzhol zhing 'bab lags na// bskul na smos kyang ci 'tshal te// de slad 'phrin 'di gleng bar bgyi// khyod kyi phun tshogs gang lags pa// stes dbang gis ni brnyes pa dang*// ngo bo nyid dang gnam dang ni// lha yis byin pa ma lags shing*// nyid kyi sku tshes snga ma la// dge ba spyad pa'i dbang dang ni// yab dang yum dang ma ma dang*// phan par bgyis pas bskrun pa lags// de slad dge la dgyes pa dang*// yab dang yum dang gnyen bshes kyi// byas pa drin du gzo ba dang*// drin la lan gyis blan par mdzod// mi gang brtul zhugs legs 'dzin dang*// rigs dang yon tan ldan pa ni// 'dus pa'am ni re re la'ang*// khyod kyis gus dang bkur bar bgyi// mgon med pa dang nad pa dang*// glo bur lhags dang rgan po dang*// dran pa nyams par gyur la sogs// nyams thag brtse bas bskyang bar mdzod// shes ldan nor gyis phongs pa dang*// ya rabs rgud par gyur pa dang*// log par ltung ba dag la yang*// brnyas par mi bgyi phan par bgyi// byad dang dug sbyor bgyid pa dang*// g.yo dang sgyu yis spyod pa dag /tshul de dag las bzlog pa'am/ yang na ring du bskrad par mdzod// mi gang rig pas 'byor pa dang*// gzhan la phan pa lhur len dang*// drang po'i tshul la legs brten pa// ring na gnas kyang dgug par bgyi// sngon gyi rgyal pos bcas pa'i khrims// gna' lugs rnying pa lags mod kyang*// 'gro la gnod 'gyur spang bgyi ste// phan 'gyur kun du spel bar mdzod// khrims su bca' ba gang lags pa// ha cang zhib na skye bo rnams// shin tu gdung bar 'gyur ba dang*// bca' ba'ang myur du 'jig 'gyur lags// bcas pa snga ma snga ma rnams// phyi ma phyi mas sun phyung na// 'bangs kyis ci bgyi mi 'tshal bas// bca' ba brtan po nyid du mdzod// nyung ngu'i don la mang po dang*// chung ngu'i don la chen po la// 'phral gyi ched du gtan gyi don// yongs su nyams par mi bgyi'o// 'di bgyi 'di las 'di 'dra'i don// 'grub ches snyan par gang smra ba// rang don bsgrub pa shas che bas// dpyod pa zhib mos dpyad par bgyi// rtag res 'khor dang sho gom sogs// ha cang bsdu ba mang gyur na// bzho ba mang ba'i ba bzhin du// skam par 'gyur ba'i dogs pa mdzod// bung ba yis ni sbrang rtsi ltar// cung zad dus su sdud pa dang*// bsdus nas chud zos mi bgyid pa// 'di ni legs par rnyed pa lags// gdug pa'i sbrul gyis mi la ltar// mi brtse thabs la mi mkhas pas// dpyod pa gzhan la nyer gnod pa'i// rnyed pa shin tu smad pa lags// khyod kyi sras la ji bzhin du// 'bangs la phan pa nyer dgongs na// bu yi pha la ji bzhin du// gus pas rjed par 'gyur ba dgongs// byin pas dge ba rjes 'brang bas// 'jig rten gzhan du bde ba ste// spyad pa bde dang rjes 'brel pas// 'dir ni dga' ba bskyed pa lags// de slad bsod nams zhing dang ni// dman pa'i zhing la dus kun du// dgos pa dag dang rjes mthun par// sa bon lhug par gdab tu gsol// dus dang gnas skabs mkhyen bgyis nas// 'tshe ba med pa'i dpal 'phel ba'i// longs spyod dag la bdag dang gzhan// dgyes dgur spyod pa lha yi tshul// longs spyod log par spyod pa dang*// mi spyod chud zos nyid 'gyur ba// log pa'i don dang don med par// mkhyen nas nyid kyis spang bar mdzod// rang gi bkur sti lhag bgyid dang*// chog mi shes par longs spyod dang*// gzhan gyi dpal la zhe sdang ba// bsod nams 'dzad pa'i rgyu gsum lags// gnyid kyi bde ba'i ro myang dang*// sgyid lug pa la brten pa dang*// bre mo'i gtam la dga' ba ste// bya ba nyams pa'i rgyu gsum lags// 'khrig la kun du sred pa dang*// chang gi ro la chags pa dang*// spyod lam bag med bgyid pa ste// nad skyed pa yi rgyu gsum lags// nongs med sems can 'gum bgyid dang*// mi ma yin la tho 'tsham dang*// dus kyi cho ga'i rgyun gcod pa// tshe 'dzad bgyid pa'i rgyu gsum lags// mchod 'os bkur bar mi bgyid dang*// mnyam pa dag la 'gran pa dang*// dman pa dag la brnyas pa ste// tshul nyams bgyid pa'i rgyu gsum lags// de dag rnams ni de lta bu'i// ngang tshul lags par mkhyen bgyis nas// nyid kyang de las ldog pa dang*// gzhan dag kyang ni bzlog tu gsol// de yis nyid dpal 'phel ba dang*// don grub bde bar gnas pa dang*// tshe 'phel ba dang tshul bzhin du// spyad pas bdag gzhan bde bar 'gyur// legs par bgyis la bya dga' dang*// nongs par spyod la chad pa yis// srid 'bangs 'chos par bgyid pa ni// sa skyong rnams kyi lugs lags mod// de tshul legs par brtag bgyi ste// bya dga' 'tsham pa 'tsham pa yis// de nyid la ni sman pa dang*// gzhan yid mi bzod med par mdzod// chad pa'ang nad phyir gtar dpyad ltar// na smad bgyid pa rigs lags kyi// nad med bgyid slad gsod pa ltar// srog dang bral bgyid de ltar min// ngang tshul ngan pa'i skye bo yis// re zhig legs pa bgyis lags kyang*// ha cang gzengs bstod mi bgyi ste// de dang gzhan la'ang gnod pa'i rgyu// rang bzhin bzang po rkyen dbang gis// re zhig 'khrul par spyad bgyis kyang*// shin tu ngan smad mi bgyi ste// de yi ngang tshul de 'dra'i phyir// skyes bu'i 'bad pas ma bsgrubs pa// rtswa dang chu la sogs pa yi// 'tsho ba phal pas 'tsho bgyid cing*// 'tshe ba med par gnas bgyid pa// bya dang ri dwags la sogs la// zas kyi ched du de bzhin du// rtse 'jo'i don du 'tshe bgyid pa// gna' yi lugs su gda' mod kyang*// rigs pa dang ni mi rigs pa// rnam par dpyod pa'i yid gsal ba// khyed kyis rigs pa'i tshul brten nas// yang dag ci bzhin dpyad par bgyi// 'bru dang 'bras bu sna tshogs dang*// 'o ma zho dang lan tshwa sogs// bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs kyis// bdag nyid bde bar 'tsho bzhin du// bdag gi bde ba khyad bsad nas// mang po'i dka' spyad sna tshogs kyis// rang gi sdig dang sdug bsngal dang*// gzhan gnod sgrub pa ga la rigs// de dag rnams la'ang srog phangs shing*// lus la 'tshe ba sdug bsngal ba// de yi dpe ni bdag nyid de// bdag la ji ltar gda' ba dgongs// mtshon chas lag brel 'jigs 'jigs 'dras// bskor bas 'bros pa'i gnas med cing*// rtabs pas gom pa khyor khyor po// 'jigs pas rig rig lta ba yi// gnas skabs 'di la mi brtse na// khyod la snying rje med pa'am// gal te yod na gang zhig la// 'jug par 'gyur ba gsung du gsol// 'on kyang lugs su gyur pa'i slad// kun nas dgag par mi spyod na// cha shas kyis ni spang bar bgyi// de tsam khyod kyis cis mi spyod// 'jig rten dag dang bstan bcos las// smad dang 'tshe ba spang bgyi zhing*// bsngags dang phan pa gang lags pa// dwang du bzhes shing spel du gsol// mdor na nyid dpal 'phel ba dang*// gzhan gyi dpal la mi gnod dang*// dpal yang dpal gyi rgyur 'gyur ba// de 'dra kho nar mdzad du gsol// srid 'bangs bde bar bgyid pa dang*// bde ba rgyud mar brgyud pa dang*// rang gi gdung rgyud rgyun brtan pa// lugs kyi 'bras bu de tsam lags// dpal mgrin rang byung 'jug sred dang*// lha yi bla ma yid srubs rtsen// lha min bla ma 'bod sgrogs sogs// che ba'i che bar grags rnams dang*// ser skya gzegs zan rkang mig dang*// 'ug phrug pa la sogs pa yi// blo gsal rnams kyis sbyar ba dang*// lab gin mi sha ha dang ni// ma hā med la sogs pa yi// log rtog rnams kyis sbyar ba'i gzhung*// de kun mtha' gnyis la 'chel zhing*// dngos dang brgyud pas rang gzhan la// gnod par 'gyur ba de slad du// srid dang ngan 'gro kho na'i rgyur// shes rab gsal ba khyod kyis ni// gsal bar mkhyen nas spang du gsol// don ngan pa yi tshig legs kyang*// ro zhim pa yi dug bzhin du// gnas skabs dga' ba bskyed lags kyang*// phyi nas sdug bsngal kho na'i rgyu// nang du nye bar ma zhi ba'i// kun spyod bzang po ston lags kyang*// yid brtan rung ba ma lags te// chu skyar dang ni byi la bzhin// srid pa'i rtsa ba mi gcod pa'i// gnas skabs zhi bar bgyid lags kyang*// nges par 'byung ba ma lags te// tsha ba'i rims la chu grang bzhin// de slad yang srid sun 'byin zhing*// thar pa dam pa thob bgyid pa// bde bar gshegs pa kho na'i gsung*// de yang dge ba'i bshes las btsal// tshul khrims phung pos sku dul zhing*// mang du gsan pas gsung yang dag

/ting nge 'dzin gyis thugs zhi la// brtse bas sems can rjes 'dzin pa'i// bshes gnyen bshes kyi dam pa ste// de 'dra gang na su bzhugs kyang*// de la sangs rgyas nyid ji bzhin// shin tu gus pas bsten par bgyi// de las yan lag brgyad pa yi// bsnyen gnas blangs nas bsrung bar mdzod// de tsam gyis kyang 'dod lha'i dpal// thob par 'gyur zhes rgyal bas gsungs// gzhan yang ji ltar nus pa yi// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa yis// khyod kyi brtul zhugs mdzes par mdzod// de ni lam rnams kun gyi gzhi// theg pa che la ma gtogs par// thar pa chen po mi 'thob pas// khyod thugs theg pa chen po la// kun nas gzhol zhing goms par mdzod// gang la skyabs na bslu 'gyur ba'i// yul de skyabs gnas ma lags pas// lha dang 'byung po la sogs pa'i// chen po'ang 'dir ni mchod bya tsam// 'phags pa rang rgyal la sogs pa// nye bar zhi la rab gzhol ba// de dag phyag bgyir 'os pa ste// gnas skabs kyi ni skyabs su'ang bgyi// de slad bag chags bcas pa yi// nyes pa yong ye ma mchis shing*// nyams pa med pa'i yon tan gter// thub pa kho na skyabs kyi mchog /skyabs mchog de 'dras legs gsungs shing*// de yi go 'phang thob bgyid pa// tshul de'ang bgrod par bgyi ba yi// skyabs su gyur pa nyid lags la// de yi rjes 'jug de nyid kyi// ye shes rgya mtshor nyer 'bab pa'i// byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun yang*// slob pa'i gnas skabs kyi ni skyabs// de la skyabs pa'ang yang dag par// blangs shing brda las byung ba dang*// chos nyid kyis ni thob pa las// snga ma med par phyi ma min// de phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen nas// bdag dang sesam can ma lus pa// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// thob bya'i don du skyabs mchi nas// skyes bu mchog la brten pa dang*// de las dam chos mnyan pa dang*// thos pa ji bzhin bsgrub pa ste// thun mong bslab bya rnam gsum dang*// sangs rgyas min la ston pa dang*// chos ma yin la lam dang ni// dge 'dun min la grogs mchog tu// yongs su gzung bar mi bgyi ba// so so'i bslab pa rnam gsum la// kun nas yongs su bslab bgyi zhing*// sdug bsngal tshe na tshul de las// bdag gzhan thar phyir gsol ba dang*// bde ba myong tshe dkon mchog gi

/bka' drin nyid ces rjes dran bgyi// gang tshe sangs rgyas chos sku dang*// chos ni don dam zab mo dang*// gang gis dge 'dun byed chos dang*// bdag nyid tha dad med shes pas// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun las// bdud rnams bye ba brgya yis kyang*// gang phyir dbye bar mi nus pa// de phyir dge 'dun zhes bshad de// de tshe de ni chos nyid kyis// thob pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba lags// de lta'i skyabs su 'gro ba ni// yon tan ma lus kun gyi gzhi// skyabs de yang dag blangs gyur nas// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi ste// sems de'ang kun rdzob don dam pa// rnam pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa lags// kun rdzob pa yi byang chub sems// smon pa dang ni 'jug pa gnyis// sems can don byed rdzogs pa yi// byang chub thob 'dod smon pa ste// yul gyi mdun du cho ga yis// thob par bya zhes dam 'cha' ba// smon pa yi ni sems bskyed lags// sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs tshul kun// bsgrub par 'dod pa 'jug pa'i sems// dam 'cha' 'jug pa'i sems bskyed lags// zhum dang sgyid lug 'khor ba yi// nyes pas skrag pa'i yid gsum spang*// 'gro la byams dang snying rje dang*// srid ngad zhi ba'i nyes dmigs dang*// sangs rgyas yon tan rjes dran pa// bsgom par bgyi ba lnga po dang*// grogs bzang nye bar bsten pa yis// byang chub smon pa bsrung bar bgyi// mchod par 'os pa bslu ba dang*// gnas ma yin la 'gyod bskyed dang*// sems can mchog la skur 'debs dang*// g.yo dang sgyu yis spyod pa'i tshul// nag po'i chos su gsungs pa bzhi// rnam pa kun du spang bgyi zhing*// bden zhing rigs par smra ba dang*// sgyu med 'gro la phan sems dang*// rgyal sras bkur zhing bsngags pa dang*// theg pa che la yid sbyor ba// dkar po'i chos su gsungs bzhi la// kun nas yongs su goms par bgyi// rnyed dang bkur sti chags pa yis// bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang*// sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la// ser snas chos nor mi ster dang*// gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par// khros nas gzhan la rdeg pa dang*// theg pa chen po spong byed cing*// dam chos 'drar snang ston pa rnams// rtsa ba'i ltung bar gsungs pa'i phyir// las de dag las ldog par bgyi// dkon mchog gsum dang dge ba'i bshes// ci 'byor pa yis mchod pa dang*// dge ba'i las dang rnal 'byor la// ci nus pa yis brtson pa dang*// rang gi spyod yul gyur pa yi// 'gro la phan pa nyer sbyor ba// thos pa bsags nas thos pa'i don// snod dang 'tsham par 'chad pa bzhi// bsgrub par bgyi ba'i chos lags pas// dus las mi 'da' bsgrub par bgyi// sdig la 'gyod cing bshags pa dang*// gzhan gyi dge la yi rang dang*// bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba dang*// chos kun sgyu mar shes pa bzhi// thabs la mkhas pa'i chos lags pa'i// tshul de dag la bslab par mdzod// 'di dag 'jug pa sems bskyed pa'i// bslab par bya ba smos pa lags// rkyen la ma ltos chos med cing*// ltos phyir ngo bos de ma grub// ngo bo med la skye ba dang*// 'gag pa la sogs khyad par ci// de ltar chos kun spros bral bar// shes nas dmigs pa med pa'i yid// mnyam gzhag goms pas gzung 'dzin gyi// 'ching ba kun las rnam grol bas/

dam pa rnams kyi spyod yul ba'i// ye shes mngon par byang chub pa// 'di ni don dam byang chub sems// chos nyid kho nas thob pa lags// sems de mthar phyin bgyi slad du// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyis// rang gi yon tan rdzogs bgyi zhing*// zang zing sbyin dang snyan smra dang*// don spyod pa dang don mthun pas// gzhan gyi don kun legs bsgrub cing*// zhi gnas lhag mthong gus bstan pas// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor lam la// bgrod nas mthong pa'i lam zhugs te// rab tu dga' dang dri ma med// 'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro can// sbyang dka' ba dang mngon du gyur// ring du song dang mi g.yo ba// legs pa'i blo gros chos sprin gyi// sa rnams kun gyi rtogs pa dang*// yon tan rim bzhin mngon byas nas// bsgom pa'i lam rnams yongs rdzogs te// mthar phyin pa yi lam gyis ni// sgrib pa bag chags bcas spangs nas// dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig pa'i// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin// mtshan dang dpe byed 'bar ba'i sku// ye shes lnga dang dbyer med la// yan lag drug cu'i sgra dbyangs kyis// theg pa mchog gi chos ston zhing*// sras dang lhan cig zag med kyi// bde la rdzogs par longs spyod pa// mi 'gyur rgyun mi 'chad bzhin du// 'gro ba rnams kyi mos pa bzhin// kun la sna tshogs kun snang bas// kun gyi don mdzad sprul pa dang*// bcas pa'i go 'phang legs brnyes nas// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// 'khor ba'i 'khor lo ji srid du// srid dang zhi ba'i rgyan du 'gyur// sngon gyi skyes mchog dpag med pas// tshul lugs de 'dras sangs rgyas brnyes// da ltar bzhugs pa'i rgyal sras rnams// ring por mi thogs de 'drar 'gyur// gang dag 'di la 'jug 'gyur ba// de dag ma 'ongs sangs rgyas lags// de slad khyod kyang tshul 'di yis// srid zhi'i dpal du mdzad du gsol// gdung rgyud dam par legs 'khrungs shing*// dpal 'byor mchog gi lham me ba// rgyal bu no mo gan gyis ni// ring nas yongs su bskul gyur nas// gtsug lag gnyis kyi tshul gsal bar// ston pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di// lugs dang lung gi rjes 'brang nas// rigs pa yis kyang dpyad de bshad// khyed thugs dad pas bskul nas ni// bdag yid dge bas sbyar 'di la// nyan zhing gzhan las gsan pa'am// yang na gzigs par mdzad du gsol// lung dang shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la// shes rab shin tu ma sbyangs pas// 'di la nongs pa gang mchis pa// dam pa rnams kyis bzod par dgongs// de las dge ba gang bskrun pas// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa// theg pa mchog gi lam zhugs nas// sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog

/rgyal bu no mo gan la spring ba'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni/ chos thams cad la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ 'phags pas chu pho spre'u'i lo de bzhin gshegs pas cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la shing kun du sbyar ba'o// yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
